name: Public data
content:
The positions of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune for 1979 to 2050 are tables generated with the JPL Horizons on-line solar system data and ephemeris computation service of the Solar System Dynamics group, NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology (https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/horizons/).

Horizons output is public data. Star Chart carries the tables as Horizons wrote them, header included, and credits NASA/JPL.
